category_title: Preschoolers at risk for developmental delays with mild to moderate language disorders
scenario_title: Sustaining peer interaction during active play
minimal_context: The student is participating in a 10-minute play session with manipulative toys in the classroom to rehearse play behaviors.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our 10-minute play session. You can play with the cars and blocks with your partner.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits near the blocks and appears lonely, making no comments to the peer.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why don't you talk to your friend?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows anxiety and struggles to initiate a conversation, remaining completely silent.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just ask him a question about the cars.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks highly anxious during the awkward moment) Where is the car? Where is the car? Where is the car? Where is the car?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our 10-minute play session. You can play with the cars and blocks with your partner.

STUDENT: (Sits near the blocks and appears lonely, making no comments to the peer.)

STUDENT: (Shows anxiety and struggles to initiate a conversation, remaining completely silent.)

TUTOR: Just ask him a question about the cars.

STUDENT: (Looks highly anxious during the awkward moment) Where is the car? Where is the car? Where is the car? Where is the car?
